# Mom's Kitchen

> Authentic Homestyle Tiffin & Meal Subscription Platform in Delhi NCR & Gurugram.

Mom's Kitchen delivers freshly prepared, nutritious Indian meals (ghar ka khana) daily to homes and offices across Delhi NCR and Gurugram. Orders, customizations, and subscriptions are managed directly through an automated WhatsApp system (+91 70335 58836).

## Subscription Plans

- **Starter Pack**: 6 Meals @ ₹480 (4 Butter Rotis, Seasonal Sabzi, Dal Tadka, Steamed Rice, Salad & Pickle)
- **Regular Pack**: 12 Meals @ ₹900 (4 Butter Rotis, 2 Seasonal Veggies, Dal Tadka, Basmati Rice, Friday Dessert, Salad & Pickle)
- **Family Pack**: 24 Meals @ ₹1,680 (Double standard thali, large portions, extra sides, weekend specials)
- **One-Time Trial Pack**: 1 Meal @ ₹100 for quality testing with zero commitment

## Service Areas & Kitchen

- **Delivery Coverage**: South Delhi, Central Delhi, North Delhi, and Gurugram (Udyog Vihar, DLF phases, Cyber City).
- **Kitchen Address**: Udyog Vihar Phase 4, Sector 18, Gurugram, Haryana 122022, India.
- **Delivery Windows**:
  - Lunch: 12:00 PM – 2:00 PM (Pause cutoff: 9:00 AM same day)
  - Dinner: 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM (Pause cutoff: 4:00 PM same day)
